title: Academic medical postgraduates: a competence iceberg model and measurement development
core_idea: To construct a maturity-focused competence (iceberg) model for academic medical postgraduates and develop a corresponding measurement tool to clarify the competency domains that should be prioritized in training physician-scientists; implemented using a mixed-methods design combining qualitative item generation and quantitative factor-analytic refinement and iterative testing.
tldr: Study aims to define core competencies for academic medical postgraduates and produce a measurement instrument to guide training and assessment of physician-scientist development using mixed qualitative and quantitative methods.
